spans.s: उद्गति f. 1. Going up, ascent; 2. rise, origin; 3. vomiting.
उद्गंधि a. 1. Fragrant, विजृंभणोद्गंधिषु कुड्मलेषु R.xvi.47; 2. having a strong smell (good or bad).
उद्गम m. 1. Elevation; 2. rising, standing erect, K.S.vii.77, Am.
; 3. appearance, creation, production, R.iv.9, Am.
; 4. a shoot, हरिततृणोद्गमशंकया मृगीभिः Kir.v.38; 5. vomiting, Rt.vi.8.
उद्गमन n. Rising, ascending.
उद्गमनीय n. Bleached clothes, गृहीतपत्युद्गमनीयवस्त्रा K.S.vii.11, or धौतोद्गमनीयवासिनी (तत्स्यादुद्गमनीयं यत् धौतयोर्वस्त्रयोर्युगम् Am.ii.6.112; but not necessarily a pair. See Mall. on K.S.vii.11)
उद्गाढ a. (f. ढा) Excessive, much, परिचयादुद्गाढरागोदयाः M.M.v. (उद्गाढम् means ‘extremely,’ ‘excessively.’)
उद्गाढ a. (f. ढा) Excessive, much, परिचयादुद्गाढरागोदयाः M.M.v. (उद्गाढम् means ‘extremely,’ ‘excessively.’)
उद्गातृ m. One of the four chief priests at a sacrifice.
उद्गार m. 1. Spitting out, vomiting; 2. emitting, giving out, oozing, going out, R.iv.57, vi.60, Megh.ii.6; 3. eructation; 4. spittle, saliva.
उद्गिरण n. 1. Vomiting; 2. eructation; 3. extirpation.
उद्गीति f. 1. Singing; 2. chanting of the Sāmaveda; 3. a variety of the āryā metre. (See App. I.)
उद्गीथ m. 1. Chanting of the Sāmaveda; 2. the second part of the Sāmaveda, भूयांस उद्गीथविदो वसंति Ut.ii.; 3. a designation of ओम् the tri-literal name of God.
उद्गीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Vomited; 2. let out, emitted, poured out.
उद्गीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Vomited; 2. let out, emitted, poured out.
उद्गूर्ण a. (f. र्णा) Uplifted, raised.
उद्गूर्ण a. (f. र्णा) Uplifted, raised.

उद्ग्रंथ m. A section, a chapter^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251217. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/102.
उद्ग्रह m. 1. Taking up; 2. any object that may be accomplished by religious or other acts; 3. eructation.
उद्ग्राह m. 1. Lifting up, taking up; 2. eructation.
उद्ग्रहण n. 1. Lifting up, taking up; 2. eructation.
उद्ग्राहणिका f. Replying in argument.
उद्ग्राहित a. (f. ता) 1. Excellent, exalted; 2. tied, bound; 3. deposited, delivered; 4. lifted up; 5. recalled, remembered.
उद्ग्राहित a. (f. ता) 1. Excellent, exalted; 2. tied, bound; 3. deposited, delivered; 4. lifted up; 5. recalled, remembered.
उद्ग्रीव a. (f. वा) One having the neck uplifted, Am.
उद्ग्रीव a. (f. वा) One having the neck uplifted, Am.
